title: Auto Loans: payment extension limits by product
content:
# Auto Loans: payment extension limits by product

This limits table governs payment extensions on each Auto Loans product at PCB. It states how many installments one extension may defer, how many extensions may be granted in any rolling 365 days and over the life of the loan, how long the loan must have been funded, how many scheduled installments must already have been paid, and the most days past due a loan may be on the day an extension is granted.

## Meaning of each limit

- **Installments per extension**: the most installments one extension may defer; a whole count.
- **Extensions in any rolling 365 days**: the most extensions granted in any rolling 365 calendar days.
- **Extensions over the life of the loan**: the most extensions granted over the life of the loan.
- **Minimum loan age**: whole months since funding before an extension may be granted.
- **Minimum installments paid**: scheduled installments that must have been paid before an extension may be granted.
- **Maximum days past due**: the most days past due a loan may be when an extension is granted.

## Limits table

| Auto Loans product | Installments per extension | Extensions per rolling 365 days | Extensions over loan life | Minimum loan age (months) | Minimum installments paid | Maximum days past due |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 2 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 59 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 2 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 59 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 2 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 59 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 2 | 2 | 3 | 6 | 6 | 59 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 2 | 2 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 59 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 2 | 2 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 59 |

## Points of judgement

**Where do the products differ?** Only in the lifetime limit: 3 on the Lease Buyout Loan; 4 on the Used Vehicle, Certified Pre-Owned and Auto Refinance Loans; 6 on the New Vehicle and Green Vehicle Loans.

**Lookup illustration (hypothetical):** for a Lease Buyout Loan the table reads at most 2 installments per extension, 2 extensions per rolling 365 days, 3 over the loan's life, a minimum loan age of 6 months, 6 installments paid, and no more than 59 days past due.
